quizName:
Hardest Questions in West virginia
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What can cause distracted driving?

options.text: Talking or texting on a cell phone.
Changing a radio station or CD.

questions.explanation: Drivers must make many decisions while driving. Any extra activity can distract you from the road.

questions.question: Anything that requires you to ____ could cause you to crash.

options.text: Take your eyes off the road
Take your hands off the wheel
Take your attention away from driving

questions.explanation: Any distraction that takes your attention, eyes, or hands away from driving is dangerous.

questions.question: How can alcohol affect you?
questions.explanation: Alcohol weakens your judgment, slows your reactions, and harms your vision and balance.

questions.question: You are angry from something at work. When you get to your car, what should you do?

options.text: Play the radio loudly so you won't think about it.
Drive fast on the interstate to let off steam.
Take a few minutes to calm down before you drive.
Stop at a bar and have drinks before driving home.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to calm down before you drive.
questions.explanation: Wait until you are calm before driving. Driving while angry is dangerous for you and others on the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: When stopped by police, what must you show?
questions.explanation: You must always carry and show your license, registration, and proof of insurance when driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle and slash over a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at one-way streets and ramps. It tells you that you cannot go in that direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means when turning left at a green light, you must yield to oncoming traffic and turn only when it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs tell drivers to stop at intersections. You must yield to other traffic. You may go when it is safe.

questions.question: You miss your exit on a freeway. What should you do?

options.text: Keep driving until you reach the next exit or safe place to turn around.
Signal other drivers to stop so you can turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep driving until you reach the next exit or safe place to turn around.
questions.explanation: Do not back up on a freeway or shoulder. Drive to the next exit or safe location where you can turn around.

questions.question: What must pedestrians do?

options.text: Follow Walk and Don't Walk signals.

questions.explanation: Pedestrians must use crosswalks, look both ways, and obey Walk and Don't Walk signals. Drivers must yield to pedestrians.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Parking for people with disabled permits only.
You must turn in the direction of the arrow.
Lanes for buses and carpool vehicles only.

questions.correctAnswerText: Parking for people with disabled permits only.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means no. Right turns are not allowed where this sign is posted.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of what?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that an intersection is ahead.

questions.question: When turning or changing lanes, you must:

options.text: Always signal, even if no other traffic is visible.
Signal only if you see other traffic.
Signal only in heavy night traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always signal, even if no other traffic is visible.
questions.explanation: Always signal when turning, changing lanes, or leaving a curb. Make this a habit, even when you do not see other traffic.

questions.question: When you approach railroad tracks, you should:

options.text: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
Speed up to cross before the gate closes.
Not worry about how many tracks there are.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: At railroad tracks, look and listen for trains, slow down, and be prepared to stop.

questions.question: You are borrowing an unfamiliar car from a friend. You should:

options.text: Not worry because all cars are the same.
Hide that you are unfamiliar with the car.
Take time to learn where the controls are and how they work before driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take time to learn where the controls are and how they work before driving.
questions.explanation: Before driving an unfamiliar car, spend a few minutes learning where the turn signals, hazard lights, headlights, windshield wipers, brakes, gearshift, and horn are located. Fix any problems before driving.

questions.question: If another car is following you too closely, you should:

options.text: Get behind them and use your high beams.
Gently tap your brakes, slow down, and let them pass.
Drive slowly and block them from passing.

questions.correctAnswerText: Gently tap your brakes, slow down, and let them pass.
questions.explanation: If a driver is tailgating you, gently tap your brakes to warn them, then slow down to let them pass. If needed, pull over and stop to let them go ahead.

questions.question: When entering a highway from a driveway or private road, what should you do?

options.text: Yield to the vehicle on your left.
Yield to the vehicle on your right.
Yield to all vehicles already on the roadway.
Turn on your headlights and proceed quickly without yielding.

questions.correctAnswerText: Yield to all vehicles already on the roadway.
questions.explanation: When entering a highway from a driveway, alley, or private road, you must yield to all traffic already on the roadway. Only enter when it is safe.

questions.question: What should you do before turning?
questions.explanation: Always turn on your signal 3 to 4 seconds before you turn. This warns other drivers of your actions.

questions.question: What can impair a person's ability to drive?
questions.explanation: Safe driving requires good physical condition. Alcohol, medications, illegal drugs, and fatigue can all impair your driving ability.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a regulation sign. It tells drivers what they must and must not do. This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A circular sign warns drivers of a railroad crossing. When you see this sign, watch for trains and be ready to stop.
